name: Inflict Serious Wounds
text:
**Inflict Serious Wounds**

**School** necromancy; **Level** antipaladin 4, cleric 3, inquisitor 3, occultist 3, oracle 3, shaman 3, spiritualist 3, warpriest 3, witch 4
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** touch
**Target** creature touched
**Duration** instantaneous
**Saving Throw** Will half; **Spell Resistance** yes

This spell functions like inflict light wounds, except that it deals 3d8 + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15).
